sources.quote: Мир (Myr) + -о- (-o-) + -слав (-slav) from Old East Slavic Миросла́въ (Miroslávŭ), from Proto-Slavic *Miroslavъ, from *mȋrъ (“peace, world”) + *slàva (“glory, fame”). Cognate with Belarusian Мірасла́ў (Mirasláw), Russian Миросла́в (Mirosláv), Polish Mirosław, Czech Miroslav.

Cognate with Belarusian Мірасла́ў (Mirasláw), Russian Миросла́в (Mirosláv), Polish Mirosław, Czech Miroslav.
